verdict.rationale: Fathom documents AI-generated action items as a product feature, and its webhooks and API can deliver them automatically after each meeting (include_action_items), so the extraction itself is first-party. The evidence never shows owner assignment on action items or an in-product place to collect and track them. Pushing them into a tracker relies on the user building a webhook consumer. Missing for 10: evidence that action items carry owners/assignees, a native consolidated action-item list or tracker (or task-tool sync), independent or hands-on corroboration of extraction quality.
